Business Unit: Fitch Group
Category: Information Technology
Location:
Manchester, GB
Date Posted: Sep 22, 2026
**Senior Director, Engineering – Corporates, Financial Institutions \& Sovereigns**
===================================================================================


**Fitch Ratings**


**The Opportunity**
-------------------


Fitch Ratings is looking for a builder, a challenger, and a boundary\-pusher to lead the engineering organization responsible for all applications and services powering our Corporates, Financial Institutions, and Sovereigns lines of business. This is not a role for someone who optimizes within the status quo — it's a role for someone who questions it, reimagines it, and has the courage and capability to do something about it.


As Senior Director, you will have executive ownership of four engineering teams comprising a couple of dozen engineers. You'll lead a talented, multidisciplinary group tackling some of the most consequential technology challenges in global financial intelligence — maintaining and evolving the systems that analysts and clients depend on today, while simultaneously building the next generation of platforms from a position of real creative freedom and organizational backing.


This is a role for someone who moves fast, experiments boldly, and doesn't wait for permission to try something new. Someone who has broken things in the pursuit of building something better, who sees constraints as invitations to be clever, and who brings an infectious sense of possibility that raises the ambition of everyone around them. If you've spent time deep in machine learning or AI systems — not just using them, but building them — that's not just a bonus, it's the kind of background that makes this opportunity even more compelling. But this role goes far beyond any single discipline: it's about leading a culture of relentless innovation across every dimension of how software gets built and delivered.


**We'll Count on You To**
-------------------------


**Challenge the conventional and set a bolder technical vision** Own the strategic direction, execution, and engineering culture of four high\-performing full\-stack engineering teams. But more than managing what exists — interrogate it. Ask the uncomfortable questions about why things are built the way they are, and lead your teams toward answers that are smarter, faster, and more powerful. Set a technical vision that doesn't just improve the current state but genuinely reimagines what's possible for the platforms powering Fitch's most critical analytical work.


**Build, develop, and inspire exceptional people** Lead, mentor, and empower a team of team leads and engineers across a range of technical backgrounds and experience levels. Foster a culture where intellectual curiosity is celebrated, where experimentation is encouraged, and where people feel safe enough to take risks and learn loudly from what doesn't work. Attract and retain engineers who are hungry, inventive, and proud of both the quality of what they ship today and the audacity of what they're building toward.


**Reimagine and modernize critical platforms** Oversee the full lifecycle of the applications and services central to Fitch's Corporates, Financial Institutions, and Sovereigns analytical workflows. Balance the discipline of maintaining production\-grade systems with the creative ambition to tear down and rebuild what no longer serves the business well. Be the person in the room who asks "what if we started over?" — and who knows when that's exactly the right call.


**Drive greenfield innovation without apology** Identify and actively pursue opportunities to design and build net\-new applications and platforms that replace or leapfrog legacy approaches. Embrace the blank canvas — and bring the rigor of world\-class software delivery with you. This is an organization that wants to see bets placed, experiments run, and lessons learned fast. Be the kind of leader who creates that energy and channels it into things that last.


**Push the frontier of AI, ML, and intelligent systems** Go beyond adopting AI tools — define how intelligent systems become structural, load\-bearing parts of the platforms your teams own. Whether that's LLM\-powered workflows, ML models embedded in analytical processes, agentic automation, or AI\-augmented developer tooling, bring the depth to evaluate, architect, and champion these capabilities with real technical conviction. If you've built ML systems from the ground up, that experience will resonate deeply here — and you'll have the platform to apply it in genuinely high\-stakes, high\-visibility ways.


**Influence across a complex and interconnected stakeholder landscape** Act as a strategic partner to a broad and diverse set of stakeholders — including senior leadership, analytical teams, operations, and business relationship management — whose workflows and outcomes depend directly on the platforms your teams own. Navigate a rich ecosystem of technical interdependencies, partnering with peer engineering teams whose systems integrate with, depend on, or are shaped by what your teams build. Build organizational credibility through consistent delivery, clear technical vision, and the ability to bring bold ideas to life in ways that earn trust across the business.


**What You Need to Have**
-------------------------


* **18\+ years of hands\-on software engineering experience**, with substantial time in senior technical leadership roles overseeing multiple teams and disciplines
* **Proven multi\-team leadership** — demonstrated experience leading team leads and engineers across full\-stack disciplines; a track record of building high\-performing, inventive engineering cultures at meaningful scale
* **Deep technical credibility and hands\-on instinct** — strong command of modern software architecture, cloud\-native platforms, and production\-grade application delivery; you know when to go deep, and your teams and peers will know it too
* **Full\-stack engineering expertise** — proven background with modern enterprise technology stacks, including React, Java, and/or Python in production environments, deployed across AWS and/or Azure
* **A bias for experimentation and innovation** — a demonstrable history of pushing technical boundaries, challenging inherited assumptions, and driving teams toward approaches that are meaningfully better — not just incrementally improved
* **Modernization and greenfield experience** — proven ability to evolve existing platforms while simultaneously designing and delivering new systems; comfort making bold architectural decisions in both constrained legacy and open greenfield environments
* **People leadership and talent development** — demonstrated ability to attract, grow, and retain exceptional engineers and engineering leaders; a builder of teams as much as systems, with a genuine investment in the growth of the people around you
* **Cross\-functional stakeholder management** — proven ability to partner effectively across analytical, operational, and business\-facing teams as well as peer technical organizations; skilled at managing competing priorities and driving alignment across a complex interdependency landscape
* **Executive communication** — the ability to translate bold technical vision for non\-technical audiences, build trust through delivery, and make complex ideas land clearly at every level of the organization
* **Education:** Bachelor's, Master's, or PhD in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Machine Learning, or a related technical field — or equivalent expertise demonstrated through impact

**What Would Make You Stand Out**
---------------------------------


* **An ML or AI engineering background** — if you've spent meaningful time building machine learning systems, training models, designing intelligent pipelines, or architecting AI\-native applications, that depth is genuinely exciting for this role and will shape how you lead, what you build, and the kind of talent you attract
* **Deep cloud\-native expertise** — hands\-on mastery of AWS and/or Azure, Docker, Kubernetes/EKS, microservices architecture, and sophisticated CI/CD and deployment pipelines for large\-scale application delivery
* **Generative AI and intelligent systems experience** — hands\-on experience with LLMs, RAG architectures, agentic workflows, or production ML systems; the ability to move between engineering credibility and strategic vision without losing altitude
* **AI\-native delivery leadership** — direct experience implementing AI\-augmented development lifecycles, intelligent testing pipelines, or AI\-assisted tooling that materially raises the quality and velocity of engineering teams
* **Transformation and platform modernization leadership** — a history of successfully reimagining complex, production\-critical platforms while maintaining delivery continuity and rallying teams around a compelling future state
* **A maverick streak with enterprise judgment** — the rare combination of someone who genuinely challenges conventions and moves with urgency, but knows how to do it within a complex organization without losing stakeholders along the way
* **Financial services domain knowledge** — familiarity with analytical workflows, credit ratings processes, or how technology creates leverage in financial decision\-making
* **Technical thought leadership** — contributing to open source, speaking at industry events, publishing engineering content, or establishing technical direction that influences well beyond your immediate team

**What We Offer**
-----------------


* **A genuine mandate to innovate** — not a talking point, but real organizational backing to question, challenge, and rebuild the platforms powering some of Fitch's most critical business lines
* **Executive visibility and strategic influence** — direct access to senior leadership, the platform to shape engineering direction across consequential lines of business, and the opportunity to leave a lasting mark on how global financial intelligence is delivered
* **The intersection of depth and breadth** — lead a capable, experienced engineering organization while simultaneously running a bold innovation agenda; this role sits at a genuinely rare intersection of operational accountability and creative freedom
* **A place where ML and AI expertise becomes architecture** — if you've built intelligent systems, this is an environment where that knowledge doesn't sit on the shelf; it shapes product direction, platform design, and how the organization thinks about what's next
* **Cutting\-edge technology and continuous learning** — access to the latest AI tools, frameworks, platforms; training and conference budgets; and the expectation that you'll stay at the leading edge and pull your teams forward with you
* **Career acceleration at scale** — high visibility to the most senior leaders at Fitch, a clear path to principal and executive roles, and the opportunity to define what AI\-driven financial technology looks like in practice
* **A culture that rewards curiosity** — an environment where bold ideas are welcomed, where experimentation is celebrated, and where the best thinking wins regardless of where it comes from


**Why Fitch?**
--------------


At Fitch Group, the combined power of our global perspectives is what differentiates us. Our global network of colleagues comes together to accomplish things greater than they ever could alone.


Every team member is essential to our business, and each perspective is critical to our success. We embrace a diverse culture that encourages a free exchange of ideas, guaranteeing your voice will be heard and your work will have an impact, regardless of seniority.


We are building incredible things at Fitch and we invite you to join us on our journey.

  

**About Fitch Group**
---------------------


Fitch Group is a global leader in financial information services with operations in more than 30 countries. Wholly owned by the Hearst Corporation, we are comprised of three main businesses: Fitch Ratings \| Fitch Solutions \| Fitch Learning.


For more information please visit our websites: www.fitchratings.com \| www.fitchsolutions.com \| www.fitchlearning.com


Fitch is committed to providing global securities markets with objective, timely, independent and forward\-looking credit opinions. To protect Fitch's credibility and reputation, our employees must take every precaution to avoid conflicts of interests or any appearance of a conflict of interest. Should you be successful in the recruitment process at Fitch Ratings you will be asked to declare any securities holdings and other potential conflicts prior to commencing employment. If you, or your immediate family, have any holdings that may conflict with your work responsibilities, you may be asked to divest yourself of them before beginning work.


Fitch Group is proud to be an Equal Opportunity and Affirmative Action Employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to race, color, national origin, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, protected veteran status, and other statuses protected by law.

jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer
jobs.description:
**About Nutrient**
==================


At Nutrient, we're revolutionizing how the world works with documents. Our tools transform static files into intelligent, secure workflows, empowering businesses to innovate faster and smarter. Trusted by thousands of organizations across 80 countries, including Fortune 500 companies and public sector leaders, our platform supports nearly a billion end users globally in industries where documents aren't just files, they're mission\-critical.

**Your Role at Nutrient...**
============================


As a Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) on our Sales team, your work starts with a customer:

* You will find the document problem that is actually costing them money, and build the working solution yourself, on their documents, that works with or within their environment, against a scorecard we agree on before we start.
* Then you will turn what you built into something the next customer can buy ready made. We commit to the specific outcome for the customer, and we then measure how much of each engagement converts into actual product.


Here’s how this role is different:

* If you are a **solutions engineer** today, the difference is that you ship.
* If you are a **professional services engineer** today, the difference is that the work is not billed by the hour against a spec someone else wrote, and success is not a signed\-off SOW but a customer outcome and a reusable capability in the product.
* If you are a **product engineer** today, the difference is that your users are in the room, on the call, and occasionally disagreeing with you.


This is a role for someone who is genuinely comfortable in all three chairs: the discovery conversation where you work out what job the customer is actually trying to get done, the terminal where you build it by Friday, and the seat at the table when the product is being meaningfully developed.

**What You'll Work On...**
==========================

* **Discover the problem before anyone scopes it**. Get into the customer's process deeply enough to state the job to be done in their words. Most engagements start because someone asked for a feature; the work is finding the outcome behind the request.
* **Build the first implementation yourself**. Working software on the customer's own documents and in their own environment if necessary, fast enough that the demo lands while the problem is still urgent. A prototype that shows beats a deck that tells, and a working solution closes the deal.
* **Agree a scorecard upfront and hit it.** Every engagement starts with a written definition of what success looks like and how it will be measured. We commit to that result.
* **Stitch across the whole platform**. Real solutions cut across Nutrient Workflow, Document Engine, our Document Web Services APIs, the Web and native SDKs, AI data extraction, and whatever the customer already runs. Recent engagements have meant SharePoint and Salesforce integrations, AWS Bedrock models, .NET services behind consistent\-hash routing, bulk export pipelines, and database archiving.
* **Productize what you build**. Choose the implementation that makes the next customer easier, not the one that closes fastest. In a recent engagement we deliberately built a cover\-sheet generator on AI Data Extraction rather than a SQL script, and that task is now stronger for every customer. Several deliverables from that engagement are now licensable product components and self\-service features.
* **Close the loop back into the company**. Write up what you learned, file the defects you hit, articulate the pattern so the next engagement starts from it, and hand the template to the next team. Forward deployed work that stays inside one account is just consulting.
* **Support the deal**. You will work alongside account executives and solutions engineers before the contract as well as after it. What you build during the sales cycle is often what decides whether we win.

**What You'll Bring...**
========================


The shortest description of the profile: a strong software engineer who has moved toward product thinking — you care about the problem, not the ticket — and who is unusually good with customers. You live in a world that exists beyond technical requirements and can quickly go into solution mode to deliver a working solution.  

You are likely a good fit if most of the following are true:* You can run a discovery conversation. You ask about the business process before the API, and you can tell the difference between a use case and a job to be done.
* You get real leverage out of coding agents. Our customers expect the first working version in days, not sprints, and that only happens if you direct agents well.
* You have shipped production software for years, and you still build. You are comfortable being the only engineer on a problem and being a part of a team that delivers the solution.
* You are fluent in at least one of JavaScript or TypeScript, .NET/C\#, Java, Python or Go, and you pick up the others without drama.
* You can stand up and reason about infrastructure: containers, Kubernetes, at least one of AWS, Azure or GCP, reverse proxies and load balancing, Postgres, Redis.
* You have worked with LLMs in production, not only in a notebook. Prompt and retrieval design, evaluating extraction quality, cost and latency tuning.
* You write well. Design docs, scorecards, handover notes and customer\-facing summaries are part of the output, not overhead.


It would be nice if you have:* **Document technology background**: PDF internals, OCR, layout\-aware extraction, e\-signature flows, redaction.
* **Domain time in heavily regulated industries**, such as banking KYC, insurance claims, or healthcare and life sciences.
* Experience in a forward deployed, solutions architecture or founding\-engineer role at an **infrastructure or platform company**.
* **Consulting or agency background**, if you left it because you wanted the work to compound.
* **Integration experience** with the systems enterprises actually run, such as SharePoint, Salesforce, Power Automate, or an internal system nobody has documented since 2011\.
* Comfort working with **regulated environments** and the conversations that come with them, such as HIPAA, FedRAMP, FIPS, and government cloud.


Be honest with yourself — this is probably not for you if:* You want a clean backlog and a quiet quarter. Early engagements will be ambiguous and the team's boundaries with Engineering and Professional Services are still being drawn.
* You prefer to hand off after the design. Here you build it.
* You would rather build the perfect bespoke thing than the slightly less perfect thing three more customers can use.

**Also…**
=========

* **Your first 90 days**: By day 30 you will have shadowed two live engagements and shipped one small thing a customer uses. By day 60 you will own an engagement end to end, from discovery through the agreed scorecard. By day 90 at least one thing you built will be on its way into the product as a template or a component, and you will have written up why.
* **How we will measure your impact**: Customer outcomes against the scorecards you agreed, revenue influenced through the engagements you run, and the share of your work that converts into reusable product rather than staying in one account. That last one is the number that keeps Nutrient a software company.
* **Team and location**: You will join the Forward Deployed Engineering team, reporting into Sales, working daily with Engineering and the Account teams. We are hiring in Raleigh, NC and in London. Expect meaningful travel to customer sites, concentrated in bursts around engagement kickoffs.

**Who Thrives Here...**
=======================


At Nutrient, we’re not just hiring for skills — we’re hiring for mindset. The people who thrive here are:

* **Collaborators**: You collaborate openly, listen actively, and prioritize team success over ego.
* **Hungry Learners**: Rapid learning fuels progress and career growth.
* **Curious Thinkers**: You dig deep to uncover the “why,” valuing understanding over simply being right.
* **Self\-Starters**: You take action without waiting for direction, turning obstacles into opportunities with creativity and persistence.
* **Owners**: You take responsibility for solutions and outcomes, always looking for ways to improve what’s within your control.
* **Doers**: You’re energized by progress, motivated to create meaningful impact, and eager to tackle challenges.

**Why You'll Love Working Here...**
===================================


At Nutrient, we build tools that reshape how businesses and developers work with documents. Our culture is centered on continuous growth and collaboration. Every team member has room to learn, innovate, and drive meaningful impact.

* **Real technical ownership:** you're not just managing relationships; you're running technical discovery, building POCs, and being the engineer in the room for your customers.
* **Cross\-functional influence:** your work sits at the intersection of CS, Solutions Architecture, and Support, with a direct line to shape product direction through customer advocacy.
* **Distributed and async\-first:** minimal meetings, strong writing culture, and the independence to manage your own work.
* **Mission\-critical product:** Nutrient's platform is trusted by 15%\+ of the Global 500 across 80\+ countries.
* **Strong growth trajectory:** ARR grown from $28M to $49M over the past two years, backed by Insight Partners.


Nutrient believes in equal opportunity. We employ people from many cultures and countries, celebrate diversity, and are committed to building a team that represents a variety of backgrounds, skill sets, and perspectives. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, age, marital status, national origin, ancestry, physical or mental disability, medical condition, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other non\-merit factor.

jobs.title: Principal Engineer - HVDC Systems - Convertors and Control & Protection
jobs.description:
**Base Location:** Flexible Scotland \| We're proud to offer a Flexible First approach to work, and this role is no exception. We will, however, need your base 'home' location to be one of our SSEN offices or depots around Scotland, Perth, Glasgow, Aberdeen or Inverness


**Salary:** £59,800 \- £89,800 \+ car /car allowance \+ performance\-related bonus \+ a range of benefits to support your finances, wellbeing and family.


**Working Pattern:** Permanent \| Full Time \| Flexible First options available


**The role**



As a Principal Engineer, you’ll provide technical leadership across multiple projects or portfolios, setting direction for HVDC Systems including converters and control \& protection equipment, standards and long\-term engineering decisions. The role is broader in scope and influence, with accountability for technical governance, risk and consistency, while also shaping supplier strategy, driving innovation, representing the business externally and building capability across the wider engineering community.



We’d also welcome applications from candidates who feel they may not meet all may not yet meet every requirement of the Principal Engineer position and would be happy to be considered for a Senior Engineer position.

  


**You will**


* Write, review existing, maintain, and own technical specifications and guidance notes required for all for all HVDC Converter and Control \& Protection Equipment (i.e. HVDC systems, Converters, Valves, C\&P MACH \& DCSS) used on the Transmission network – Responsible for integrating with existing SSEN specifications for HVDC.
* Provide technical guidance and advice to the transmission business for HVDC network development, refurbishment, or fault investigations of failed plant.
* Participate and lead in supplier engagement and innovation projects for evaluation of new technologies for use in HVDC applications
* As part of the HVDC Technical Authority, review test plans and witness tests to ensure that HVDC technology and equipment selected is adequately tested, proven, validated, and review proposed suppliers to confirm their suitability to be approved for use on the transmission network.
* Provide Subject Matter Expert input to design reviews carried out by the Design Authority, provide specialist input where required and verify project proposals are fit for purpose and identify any scope changes required.


**You have**


* A degree in Electrical Engineering or another relevant engineering discipline and Chartered Engineer status with a relevant institution or working towards chartered status.
* Demonstrable experience on an expert level in the design, specification, construction, control \& operation, and maintenance of HVDC Systems. Specifically, experience in the application and integration of HVDC in various environments.
* The ability and experience to technically assess issues and/or problems and critically assess a range of technical solutions and an in depth understanding of the technical requirements for development, design, planning, control, integration, and operation of HVDC Systems.
* Significant understanding of the interfaces between AC Network design and integration of HVDC Systems.
* A detailed knowledge and understanding of a range of National Grid, British and European Standards, UK grid code and SQSS alongside the capability and experience in writing technical specifications, guidance notes and work instructions for all HVDC aspects.


**About SSE**



SSE’s purpose is to provide energy needed today while building a better world of energy for tomorrow. We do this by developing, building, operating and investing in electricity infrastructure and businesses needed in the energy transition. Our Transforming for Growth investment plan sees us investing £33bn in critical electricity infrastructure across the five years to 2030\.



SSEN Transmission own and operate the electricity transmission network across the north of Scotland. We transport energy from where it is generated to where it is needed, ensuring a safe and reliable electricity supply for the communities we serve. But that's not all – we're upgrading the grid to deliver cleaner, homegrown energy for the future and building a network for net zero to create secure power for generations to come.


**Flexible benefits to fit your life**



Enjoy discounts on private healthcare and gym memberships. Wellbeing benefits like a free online GP and 24/7 counselling service. Interest\-free loans on tech and transport season tickets, or a new bike with our Cycle to Work scheme. As well as generous family entitlements such as maternity and adoption pay, and paternity leave.


**Work with an equal opportunity employer**



SSE will make any reasonable adjustments you need to ensure that your application and experience with us is positive. please contact Andy on andrew.torrance@sse.com / 01738 275370 to discuss how we can support you.



We're dedicated to fostering an open and inclusive workplace where people from all backgrounds can thrive. We create equal opportunities for everyone to succeed and especially welcome applications from those who may not be well represented in our workforce or industry.


**Ready to apply?**



Start your online application using the Apply Now box on this page. We only accept applications made online. We'll be in touch after the closing date to let you know if we'll be taking your application further. If you're offered a role with SSE, you'll need to complete a criminality check and a credit check before you start work.

jobs.title: Associate Director, Process & Platform
jobs.description:
At M\&G, our purpose is to give everyone real confidence to put their money to work. With a heritage dating back more than 175 years, we have a long history of innovation in savings and investments, combining asset management and insurance expertise to offer a wide range of solutions.
  

  

Our two distinct operating segments, Asset Management and Life, work together to provide access to balanced, long\-term investment and savings solutions.  

  

Through telling it like it is, owning it now and moving it forward together with care and integrity; we are creating an exceptional place to work for exceptional talent.  

  

We will consider flexible working arrangements for any of our roles and offer workplace adjustments to ensure you have the support you need to succeed in your role.

 **Associate Director, Process \& Platform**

  

Corporate Pension Solutions (CPS) is a division within M\&G Life with a remit to design and deliver bulk purchase annuities and alternative de\-risking products for Defined Benefit pension schemes. Due to ongoing success, a strong opportunity set, and ambitious growth plans, the team is adding headcount in a number of areas.

  

We’re looking for an exceptional individual to enable M\&G’s Digital Strategy, using technological and actuarial expertise to develop areas within the pricing platform and end\-to\-end new business processes as CPS accelerates its growth plans.

  

The Associate Director, Process \& Platform leads the development of pricing systems, models and business processes that underpin Corporate Pension Solutions' growth strategy. The role brings together actuarial, technology and process expertise to improve operational efficiency, enhance platform capabilities and deliver scalable solutions for new business pricing.

jobs.description:
Software Engineer (Mid\-Level) – Bravissimo IT


37\.5 hrs per week, Full Time, Hybrid (minimum 1 day per week in Leamington office)
  

Salary: 35\-50K

**About Bravissimo**


Part of Wacoal Europe Group, Bravissimo is an award\-winning, multi\-channel lingerie retailer on a mission to uplift women. Since 1995, our purpose has stayed the same: to inspire our customers to feel supported, celebrated, and confident every day.


We have 26 shops in the UK alongside a thriving ecommerce community, which offers a wide range of beautiful lingerie, swimwear and nightwear for women who wear a D to L cup, giving them so much choice.


We are on an exciting journey of growth and are loving every minute of it!

* The opportunity to buy up to 5 additional days holiday each year
* Access to free and confidential 24/7 employee support from Retail Trust

We're looking for a mid\-level Software Engineer to join our Back of House engineering team and help build, support and evolve a range of business\-critical applications. Working across a range of Bravissimo applications, you'll develop APIs, backend services and event\-driven solutions that support key business areas including product management, customer acquisition, ordering and fulfilment.

We're evolving towards a full\-stack engineering environment, with TypeScript, Node.js, React and AWS at the heart of our modern applications and services.

**Key Responsibilities:**

Technical environment

* REST APIs
* Event\-Driven Architecture

Experience with every technology isn't expected, but a willingness to learn and develop new skills is essential.  

  



**About you**

jobs.title: Senior Product Engineer - Pensions and Spend
jobs.description:
**Senior Product Engineer \- Investments**

**About Kota**


Kota is reimagining insurance and retirement benefits for the modern workforce. Through our two flagship products \- Kota Platform, the first fully integrated benefits platform, and Kota Embed, our embedded insurance solution \- we're making benefits more accessible, valued, and global.


Today, we power benefits for tens of thousands of employees at Europe's most forward\-thinking companies, including Carwow, Tines, Zoe, and Remote. Founded in 2022, we've raised more than €20M from leading investors such as EQT Ventures, Eurazeo, Northzone, and Frontline, as well as founders and executives from Workday, Remote, Personio, OpenAI, and more.

 **The role \& team**


We're looking for a Senior Product Engineer to join the Investments team, building the product that powers workplace pensions, retirement savings and our spend product at Kota. It's a full stack role with a backend lean, your strongest expertise will be backend and you'll work in the frontend when the product needs it.


The Investments team owns more than pensions. On one side, pension infrastructure is genuinely complex: multi\-provider, multi\-market and largely unmodernised. You'll design the systems that connect pension providers to employers and employees, covering contributions, fund data, payroll integrations and compliance across multiple markets.


On the other hand, you'll own our Spend product. This lets employers create allowances and issue cards to employees, who get a virtual Stripe card they can add to Apple or Google Wallet and spend in real time. It spans card issuing, wallet provisioning, transaction flows and the controls employers need to manage it. We want someone who starts with the customer, not the code, and proactively adds to the roadmap rather than just picking up tickets. This is an autonomous role, you'll be trusted to make product calls, not just technical ones.

 **What you'll do**

* Design and build the systems that power Kota's Investments products; pensions, retirement savings and Spend: contributions, onboarding, provider integrations, employer\-facing configuration, card issuing and wallet provisioning
* Own technical architecture for the Investments stream, integrating with external pension and savings providers as well as payment and card infrastructure (Stripe)
* Contribute to frontend code (React \+ TypeScript) when a feature calls for it
* Join client calls where it helps you understand or explain a problem, and proactively shape the roadmap rather than just picking up tickets
* Use AI actively in your day\-to\-day work, for building, reviewing and speeding up how you ship
* Contribute to code reviews and technical planning, and keep the systems you own stable and observable
* Help shape how the Investments team works as it grows

 **What we're looking for**

* 6\+ years building backend systems in production (.NET 10, PostgreSQL, Azure/AWS), comfortable picking up frontend (React/TypeScript) when needed
* Experience designing and maintaining integrations with third\-party APIs
* Strong understanding of data modelling, event\-driven patterns, and building for correctness and auditability
* A clear communicator who can talk to engineers and customers, and knows which version to use with which audience
* A product mindset and a bias to bring ideas, not just execute them, proactively adding to the roadmap
* You take real ownership, if a request from a client or lead doesn't match your own understanding of the problem, you say so rather than building to spec anyway
* You think carefully about reliability, security and compliance, and are comfortable with ambiguity and ownership in a fast\-growing startup
* AI\-forward mindset, we use AI daily to build and improve our systems and expect you to as well

 **Why join us?**

* **Technically interesting problem** \- pension infrastructure is genuinely complex: multi\-provider, multi\-market and largely unmodernised
* **Modern stack** \- .NET 10, PostgreSQL, React, TypeScript, Next.js, Azure/AWS, event\-driven
* **Agency** \- we hire people and trust them. You'll own meaningful parts of the system end to end
* **Customer proximity** \- you'll see the impact of what you build, and hear directly from the people using it
* **High\-quality culture** \- we care about clean design and thoughtful engineering
* **Impact from day one** \- we're a small, focused team. What you build ships fast and matters
* **AI\-first** \- we invest heavily in AI tooling and token usage. We're not precious about the spend, if it helps you build better or faster, use it

 **Our hiring process**

* **Introductory call (30 mins):** a casual chat with one or two of our product team
* **Technical interview (90 mins):** a collaborative, open\-book session with two engineers, working through a real\-world problem together
* **Call with founders (30 mins):** we'll share our vision and hear your thoughts
* **Final response:** we'll follow up promptly with next steps

 **Kota benefits**

* Health insurance via Kota
* Workplace pension with matched contributions up to 5% via Kota
* WFH stipend to support your home office setup
* Generous paid time off, work hard and take the time you need
* Access to office space in Dublin or a co\-working space, wherever you're based
* Flexible working hours, we're remote\-first with some fixed hours for team alignment


We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

jobs.title: Full Stack Engineer
jobs.description:
**What is Digital Speed?**

Digital Speed is a full\-service product and engineering agency delivering strategy, design, and development for global clients. Our expertise spans Brand, Discovery, UX/UI, and Full\-Stack Engineering, alongside product strategy and marketing. We partner with organisations in finance, automotive, sport, and technology to ship dependable, high\-quality outcomes at scale.We are driven by 4 key values:

* Open – We arrive with options, welcome feedback, and find the best way forward together.
* Thriving – New challenges energise us; we learn and improve as a team.
* Experts – Specialists who care about their craft and deliver results with structure.
* Caring – We take our clients’ goals as seriously as our own and build trusted relationships.

**Where do you fit in?**

You'll join as a full\-stack engineer in London, working closely with agency leadership and a client teams to build various products. Your main account will include a product aimed at engineers and AI coding agents. You'll shape high\-quality engineering practices, reusable components, strong pipelines, production\-ready software while owning the parts of the product that determine whether developers and agents actually succeed with it: documentation, onboarding, and sandbox testing. This is a role for someone who enjoys breadth and ownership: context\-switching across languages, designing for both human and machine consumers, and collaborating across agency and client teams.

**Responsibilities**

* **Core Engineering:** Design and build robust, reusable services and libraries across multiple languages (Java, .NET, Python, TypeScript, Go), for a product consumed by both developers and AI coding agents.
* **Documentation:** Build and maintain a docs\-as\-code platform \- API references, quickstarts, and guides \- structured for both human readability and machine parsing (OpenAPI/JSON Schema, MCP tool definitions, llms.txt where relevant).
* **Onboarding:** Design and build the onboarding path from signup to first successful integration \- CLI/SDK scaffolding, guided setup, and error handling clear enough for an agent to self\-correct on, not just a human.
* **Sandbox Testing:** Build isolated sandbox environments \- mock services, seeded test data, ephemeral instances \- where engineers and agents can safely test integrations without touching production.
* **Architecture \& Review:** Analyse requirements, propose technical approaches, and lead peer reviews to maintain high standards.
* **CI/CD \& Quality Gates:** Implement and refine pipelines with linting, tests/coverage, artifact signing, and versioning discipline.
* **Release Management:** Ensure clean, traceable, secure releases across environments, with strong changelog hygiene — especially important where agents consume versioned APIs programmatically.
* **Collaboration \& Handover:** Work directly with the client's Architecture/Platform teams; produce documentation, run\-books, and recorded walkthroughs as part of agency delivery.
* **Continuous Improvement:** Optimise build times, automate repeatable tasks, and keep outputs deterministic and reproducible.

**Characteristics**

* **Simplify:** Turn messy requirements into clear, repeatable systems \- and clear systems into documentation that needs no follow\-up questions.
* **High\-performance:** Care about reliability, observability, and regression safety.
* **Collaborative:** Give/receive reviews; document decisions; unblock others.
* **First\-principles:** Handle ambiguity and make trade\-offs explicit.
* **Ownership:** Proactive, organised, and comfortable leading end\-to\-end \- from architecture through to the docs page a developer or an agent is reading when they get stuck.

**Requirements**

* 5\+ years building production software (libraries, services, or dev\-tools a plus \- developer platforms or API products especially relevant here).
* Proficiency in Java \& TypeScript. Skills in C\#/.NET, Python \& Go are a bonus.
* Solid grasp of modern API and integration patterns.
* Experience building or maintaining developer\-facing documentation: docs\-as\-code, API reference generation, or interactive examples.

Mott MacDonald Bentley is a fully integrated design and build business combining the design expertise of Mott MacDonald with the contracting experience of JN Bentley to deliver award winning projects. Working for Mott MacDonald Bentley, you will work on major water and wastewater schemes throughout all phases of the project from feasibility through to construction. With an annual turnover surpassing £600 million, Mott Macdonald Bentley cements its position as a leader within the industry. The sustained, robust business performance creates an ideal environment for career growth.

  

As part of our appointment to Scottish Water’s new Enterprise, we will deliver projects at sites across Scotland. Works will include major upgrades to treatment assets, new and enhanced networks, and resilience schemes that will benefit communities across the country.

  

**25\+ years in the water sector**

  

Over successive regulatory periods, MMB has delivered a wide range of complex water and wastewater projects that directly support SR27 priorities, including:

  

* Enhancing resilience and service reliability through treatment works upgrades, network improvements and resilience schemes


* Supporting net zero and climate adaptation via low carbon design, nature based solutions and environmental compliance projects


* Enabling sustainable growth by delivering infrastructure that supports new development and protects existing communities


* Driving efficiency and affordability through integrated delivery, innovation and collaborative planning


* Maintaining a strong focus on customers, communities and safety across everything we do

  

As a Principal Civil Engineer you'll work on projects that make a real difference to our environment and our communities \- enhancing the efficiency and effectiveness of water and wastewater treatment systems.


You will play a pivotal role in shaping the civil functions throughout the lifecycle of various projects. From concept design to commissioning, you will ensure that all civil aspects are meticulously considered and integrated.

  

**The role of a Principal Civil Engineer includes:**

  

* Lead and oversee the design, planning, and execution of civil engineering on projects.


* Providing design support and guidance for schemes and ensuring all designs are fit for purpose and meet current legislation and standards


* Working closely and collaboratively with the commercial, operational and construction teams to develop efficient, practical and safe solutions throughout design stages, construction and beyond


* Positively engage with the client, managing relationships and adopting a one\-team approach to supporting them in achieving their aims


* Managing the interfaces and integration of the civil design with that of other disciplines and production of documentation


* Acting as technical checker on project documents, and undertaking technical reviews for projects across teams


* Identifying opportunities to improve delivery processes including development and implementation of standard designs, sustainable solutions, and digital tools


* Undertaking site reviews to ensure buildability of solutions and integration within the existing systems


* Supporting the development of the civil engineering team, coaching and mentoring engineers to develop their skill set and identifying the correct resource for the projects

  

**What you’ll need:**

  

* Degree in Civil Engineering, or related field


* Chartership (CEng) with a relevant Engineering Institution


* Minimum of 10 years of experience in civil engineering including hydraulic and concrete structure design.


* Proven ability to manage multiple projects and meet deadlines.


* Experience of successfully delivering high quality outputs in accordance with design, quality and safety standards


* Ability to communicate effectively with team members and stakeholders


* A willingness to travel to sites across your operational region

  

**Preferred skills:**

  

* Experience with sustainable design and green building practices.


* Proficiency in civil engineering software and tools.


* Strong understanding of regulatory requirements and industry standards applicable within the water and wastewater sector


* Experience of temporary works design

  

**What’s in it for you:**

  

Alongside our significant training and development investment and bespoke progression plan, we offer a wide range of financial, lifestyle, health and wellbeing benefits that you can tailor to your needs. At Mott MacDonald Bentley you will be offered a competitive salary which is commensurate based on your experience. Our core benefits include:

  

* Pension matched by employer up to 7%


* Option to purchase, sell and carry over annual leave


* Life assurance / Private Medical Insurance / Critical Illness Insurance and Health Screening options


* 26 weeks maternity leave, enhanced paternity and adoption leave/ Shared parental leave


* Payment of annual professional institution subscription costs


* Gym Membership discounts UK wide


* Cycle to work scheme, interest free season ticket loans and discounted dining cards also available

  

\*\*Mott MacDonald Bentley are not currently offering sponsorship to candidates under the Skilled Worker visa route in the UK. This decision is as a consequence of the changes made to the Skilled Worker route by the UK Government in April 2024\. We continue to welcome applications from candidates who are eligible for alternative immigration routes in the UK, that do not require sponsorship as a Skilled Worker now or in future.\*\*

  

**Other Information**


**About Mott MacDonald**


Mott MacDonald is a global engineering, management and development consultancy.


Our purpose is to improve society by considering social outcomes in everything we do, relentlessly focusing on excellence and digital innovation, transforming our clients’ businesses, our communities and employee opportunities.

  

A fundamental part of this is respecting each person’s differences and striving to meet their needs.


**Our values:** progress, respect, integrity, drive, excellence.

  

**We believe that because we care about what we do, we do things better.**


We know that our people are our most valuable asset, so we are dedicated to investing in them, through our comprehensive training and development schemes, exposure to the wider design and build business and endless opportunities.

  

We are committed to creating a workplace where our people are safe, have a voice, can reach their full potential, and everyone shares in the rewards.


You’ll have the opportunity to contribute to projects that benefit our communities – from helping to secure water supplies for future generations to protecting homes and businesses from flood risk – our projects make a real difference.

  

**Diversity, Equity \& Inclusion**


A Mott MacDonald Bentley we welcome applications from all sectors of the community. We are dedicated to building a diverse workplace where everyone feels included, has the opportunity to thrive, and is treated with respect.

  

Even if you don’t meet every requirement for this role but are excited about the opportunity, we encourage you to apply. Find out more about our approach to Diversity, Equity \& Inclusion here: https://www.mottmacbentley.co.uk/people.

  

We are committed to ensuring that our recruitment practices are barrier\-free and as inclusive as possible. This includes making adjustments during the job application process and throughout your future career with us. Please call 01756 691572 or email recruitment@jnbentley.co.uk to discuss any such adjustments that we can make. You can read more about our Equal Opportunities Policy here: Equality, diversity and inclusion \- Mott MacDonald

  

**Agile working**


We are committed to providing a flexible and agile working environment that supports both our employees and the needs of the business.

jobs.title: Technical Support Engineer
jobs.description:
**About Airwallex**
-------------------


Airwallex is the only unified payments and financial platform for global businesses. Powered by our unique combination of proprietary infrastructure and software, we empower over 250,000 businesses worldwide – including Brex, Navan, Qantas, SHEIN and many more – with fully integrated solutions to manage everything from business accounts, payments, spend management and treasury, to embedded finance at a global scale.


Proudly founded in Melbourne, we have a team of over 2,300 of the brightest and most innovative people in tech across 27 offices around the globe. Valued at US$11 billion and backed by world\-leading investors including T. Rowe Price, Visa, Mastercard, Robinhood Ventures, Sequoia, Salesforce Ventures, DST Global, and Lone Pine Capital, Airwallex is leading the charge in building the global payments and financial platform of the future. If you’re ready to do the most ambitious work of your career, join us.

  

**Attributes We Value**
-----------------------


We hire successful builders with founder\-like energy who want real impact, accelerated learning, and true ownership. You bring strong role\-related expertise and sharp thinking, and you’re motivated by our mission and operating principles. You move fast with good judgment, dig deep with curiosity, and make decisions from first principles, balancing speed and rigor.


You're humble and collaborative; turn zero‑to‑one ideas into real products, and you “get stuff done” end\-to\-end. You use AI to work smarter and solve problems faster. Here, you’ll tackle complex, high‑visibility problems with exceptional teammates and grow your career as we build the future of global banking. If that sounds like you, let’s build what’s next.

  

**Who We Are**


Airwallex is a technology company that revolutionises the way businesses operate globally. Our financial infrastructure provides a modern technology stack for businesses to operate internationally, without the challenges of the current global financial system.


Businesses use Airwallex as their end\-to\-end global financial services platform. Whether it’s making or receiving payments from customers, domestically or internationally, Airwallex saves businesses time and money by offering real\-time, reliable and cost\-effective financial solutions. Our web and API solutions support businesses of all sizes, from small companies to large enterprises.


In this fast\-changing digital world that is increasingly becoming borderless, our mission is to empower businesses of all sizes to grow in their own markets and around the world, and by doing so, contribute to the global economy.


**You Will**


* Work directly with developers, merchants and internal teams on post integration issues to provide technical support, consulting and best practices. External customers contact through tickets. Internal customers use different contact avenues depending on priority.
* Conduct test scenarios for technical issues with code, software, hardware, devices and endpoints.
* Install and configure test environments, payment APIs and ecommerce products.
* Communicate technical issues to customers and internal departments.
* Identify irregularities in functionality and unexpected behaviors with Airwallex products and services.
* Develop in\-depth technical information (sample code, log searching, FAQs) for distribution to customers.
* Support the communication, response and coordination between clients and internal key stakeholders and senior leadership as part of our Global Incident Management process.
* Complete occasional weekend work and holiday coverage as the business requires for on\-call duties.

**Skills And Experience You Will Bring**


* Bachelor's degree or above in Computer Science or relevant majors
* Proven years of working experience in either programming, technical support, implementation or relevant jobs.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills, able to communicate clearly and appropriately with internal and customers.
* Strong troubleshooting and problem\-solving skills
* Prioritisation, organisation and detail oriented on ticket handling, able to work on multiple urgent issues in parallel.
* Must have sufficient technical knowledge to communicate with Engineering and Product teams
* Strong willingness to provide exceptional customer service
* Demonstrated quick learning of technology and new products
* Experienced in the e\-commerce, payment, fintech industry is a plus

**Technical Skills:**


* Experience in one of the programming languages: Python, Java, php, C\#, Java Script or shell scripting
* Familiarity with Web Technologies, HTTP and HTTPS
* Experience with REST, JSON, SOAP
* Experience with SQL
* Familiarity with Splunk, Grafana
* Experience in e\-commerce, payment, fin\-tech industry is a plus

**Applicant Safety Policy: Fraud and Third\-Party Recruiters**
--------------------------------------------------------------


*To protect you from recruitment scams, please be aware that Airwallex will not ask for bank details, sensitive ID numbers (i.e. passport), or any form of payment during the application or interview process. All official communication will come from an @**airwallex.com* *email address. Please apply only through* *careers.airwallex.com* *or our official LinkedIn page.*


*Airwallex does not accept unsolicited resumes from search firms/recruiters. Airwallex will not pay any fees to search firms/recruiters if a candidate is submitted by a search firm/recruiter unless an agreement has been entered into with respect to specific open position(s). Search firms/recruiters submitting resumes to Airwallex on an unsolicited basis shall be deemed to accept this condition, regardless of any other provision to the contrary.*


**Equal opportunity**
---------------------


Airwallex is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We value diversity and anyone seeking employment at Airwallex is considered based on merit, qualifications, competence and talent. We don’t regard color, religion, race, national origin, sexual orientation, ancestry, citizenship, sex, marital or family status, disability, gender, or any other legally protected status when making our hiring decisions. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer- Software Applications
jobs.description:
**Senior Software Engineer\- Software Applications**

  

At Oxford Instruments Andor we are devoted to accelerating the greatest scientific advancements of our age. It matters to us that the products we develop make a real difference to our customers and contribute significantly to their research. We want to deliver differentiated, accessible solutions to the widest possible scientific research and industrial communities. We are a market leading organisation with a diverse and inclusive environment.  



Following an internal promotion we are hiring for a Senior Software Engineer\- Software Applicationswill work in the Software team as part of the wider Engineering \& Technology Department.

  

As a Senior Software Engineer, you will design, develop and support customer\-facing Windows desktop applications used to control and run experiments on scientific instrumentation. Working primarily with C\#, .NET and related technologies, you will contribute to software solutions that control hardware, acquire and process scientific data, and provide advanced data visualisation and analysis capabilities.

  

This is a hands\-on software engineering role supporting multiple products and projects across Andor's portfolio. You will work closely with multi\-disciplinary teams to deliver robust, maintainable and high\-quality software that enables customers to achieve groundbreaking scientific results.

  

Key responsibilities include:

  

* Design, develop, maintain and support customer\-facing Windows desktop applications using C\# and .NET.
* Contribute to the delivery of software across multiple products and projects within the Software Applications portfolio.
* Develop software that interfaces with scientific instrumentation and hardware devices for experiment control and automation.
* Implement solutions for data acquisition, processing, storage and analysis.
* Contribute to the development of data visualisation capabilities, including advanced 3D and 4D rendering and scientific imaging applications.
* Investigate and resolve software defects, performance issues and customer\-reported problems.
* Participate in software design discussions and contribute to architecture and technical decision\-making.
* Write clean, maintainable and testable code in accordance with engineering best practices.
* Participate in code reviews and contribute to continuous improvement initiatives across the development team.
* Collaborate with software engineers, test engineers, product managers and domain experts to deliver high\-quality solutions.
* Support software releases, deployment activities and ongoing product maintenance.
* Share technical knowledge and support colleagues through collaboration and peer review.
* Occasional travel to other offices and customer sites

  

The Senior Software Engineer\- Software Applicationswill have:

  

* Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering or a related technical discipline or equivalent professional experience in delivering commercial software solutions
* At least 5 years' experience in commercial software development.
* Significant hands\-on experience developing applications using C\# and .NET.
* Proven experience delivering complex software solutions through the full software development lifecycle.
* Experience working within Agile software development teams.
* Experience developing and supporting commercial desktop software applications.

  

This permanent position is based at our Belfast headquarters working a hybrid model.

  

Informal enquiries may be directed to Louise Dooley Senior Talent Acquisition Specialist via email to louise.dooley@oxinst.com

  

Please apply via this link: Andor Technology \- Oxford Instruments Careers (oxinst.com)

Please note on this occasion we are unable to provide sponsorship for visa applicants for this particular post, as such applicants must hold the right to work in the UK to be eligible.

  



**Why Oxford Instruments Andor?**

  

Our company values of being Inclusive, Innovative, Trusted and Purposeful are at the core of everything we do for our customers and our teams. At Oxford Instruments Andor, our employees are fundamental to our business success and we are delighted to provide a competitive and comprehensive benefits programme with a range of options to suit your lifestyle.

  

**UK Oxford Instruments** **Andor Benefits:**


Oxford Instruments Andor provides employees with a competitive compensation \& benefits package to suit your lifestyle.


* Health \& Wellbeing\- Mental Health First Aiders, Employee Assistance Programme (LifeWorks, Babylon and UnMind), Private Medical Insurance with BUPA for you and your dependents, Income Protection, Life Assurance and Personal Accident Insurance. Company sick pay and medical leave, Occupational healthcare Service, 2 days paid leave for volunteering each year
* Money \& Lifestyle –Pension – employer contributory scheme (6%), Share Incentive Plan, Leave Purchase Scheme, Cycle to Work scheme, Car Salary Exchange Scheme, Tech Purchase scheme. Give as You Earn. Employee discount scheme. Free Parking Onsite.
* Career –Externally accredited training and development opportunities including support with professional qualifications, Service awards, LinkedIn learning, Learning \& development programmes.
* Work Life Balance – 187\.5 holiday hours, 9 customary holidays. Flexible start and finish times, lunchtime finish on Fridays, Enhanced maternity pay, Enhanced paternity pay, Bereavement leave

  

**Oxford Instruments Andor**

  

Oxford Instruments Andor is the global leader in the pioneering and manufacturing of high\-performance light measuring solutions, bringing together the latest developments in sensors, electronics, optics and software. Our ground\-breaking low light imaging cameras, spectroscopy solutions and microscopy systems are being used to develop cures for cancer, explore deeper into space and examine clean energy sources. We are among the world’s most innovative companies in the Photonics industry, measuring light down to a single photon and capturing events occurring within 1 billionth of a second.

  

We are part of the Imaging \& Analysis Division within the wider Oxford Instruments Group. The I\&A Division also includes Materials Analysis Group which is comprised of NanoAnalysis, Asylum Research, Plasma Technology, WITec, X\-Ray Technology, FemtoTools and Magnetic Resonance. aAt Oxford Instruments, we enable the world’s leading industrial companies and scientific research communities to image, analyse and manipulate materials down to the atomic and molecular level.

  

Oxford Instruments Andor is committed to equality of opportunity and welcomes applications from all. However, our employment monitoring data tells us that women, individuals from Black, Asian and Minority Ethnic (BAME) communities and people with a disability are currently under\-represented therefore, we particularly welcome applications from these individuals. We are committed to ensuring our workplace is a safe, welcoming and inclusive place to work, which is why we subscribe to Equality Charter Marks.

Be sure to have them submit you as a referral prior to applying for this position via Talent Spotter scheme

Please do not forward candidate details in response to this advert, or to any Oxford Instruments employees or other company locations. Oxford Instruments is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited CVs.

jobs.title: Forward Deployed AI Engineer 2026 - US, COL, UK
jobs.description:
Aimpoint Digital is a market\-leading data, AI, analytics, and operations research advisory and solution engineering firm. We help organizations design, build, and operationalize enterprise\-grade data and AI platforms, decision intelligence solutions, optimization systems, and production AI applications.


We are not a commodity consulting firm. We are a technical partner to organizations that need to move beyond experimentation and deploy AI into real business workflows with the architecture, governance, reliability, and engineering discipline required for production.


We believe successful AI initiatives require much more than prompting an LLM. They require strong software engineering, scalable architecture, reliable deployment, thoughtful evaluation, and disciplined engineering practices.


**About the Role**


As a Forward Deployed AI Engineer, you will work directly with clients to design, build, deploy, and scale enterprise AI solutions. You will combine strong software engineering fundamentals with modern AI technologies to deliver production\-ready systems that create measurable business value.


You will work across the entire AI engineering lifecycle; from solution architecture and application development to deployment, evaluation, and operationalization.


**What You Will Do**


* Design, build, and deploy production AI applications, copilots, retrieval systems, and agentic workflows
* Translate business problems into scalable technical solutions using modern AI engineering best practices
* Develop backend services, APIs, and application architectures that integrate AI capabilities into enterprise systems
* Build multi\-agent systems, AI agents, workflow automation, and decision\-support systems
* Deploy AI solutions into production with appropriate security, observability, monitoring, evaluation, and governance
* Design AI systems that integrate with enterprise data platforms, APIs, databases, messaging systems, and business applications
* Collaborate with cross\-functional client teams including engineering, data, product, architecture, security, and business stakeholders
* Experience deploying and operating containerized applications on Kubernetes, including scaling, service networking, resource management, and production monitoring
* Contribute reusable accelerators, frameworks, technical assets, and thought leadership that strengthen the AI Engineering practice
* Stay current with emerging AI technologies and recommend practical approaches that improve client outcomes


**What We Are Looking For**


We are looking for engineers who enjoy solving difficult technical problems and building production software. You are comfortable moving between software engineering, AI application development, cloud architecture, and client collaboration.


You understand that successful AI systems require excellent engineering, not just excellent models.


**Required Qualifications**


* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or equivalent practical experience
* 3\+ years of professional software engineering experience building production applications
* 1\+ years designing and deploying AI or machine learning solutions into production
* Strong programming experience using Python, Java, C\#, Go, TypeScript, or similar languages
* Experience building scalable backend systems, APIs, or distributed applications.
* Experience developing AI applications using modern LLMs, machine learning models, or intelligent automation solutions
* Experience with online and offline evaluation, observability, context engineering, guardrails, and AI governance
* Experience with MLOps, LLMOps, or production deployment pipelines
* Strong understanding of software engineering principles, including testing, version control, CI/CD, code reviews, and system design
* Experience using Claude Code, OpenAI Codex, Google Antigravity, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, or other comparable coding harnesses
* Experience integrating AI applications with enterprise data sources, APIs, and business systems
* Familiarity with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, GCP, Databricks, Snowflake, or similar technologies
* Experience deploying applications using containers, Kubernetes, serverless platforms, or similar cloud\-native technologies
* Strong communication skills with the ability to explain technical concepts to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders
* Ability to independently own technical workstreams while collaborating across multidisciplinary teams


**Preferred Qualifications**


One or more of the following is a plus:


* Experience developing production APIs using frameworks such as FastAPI, Flask, Spring Boot, .NET, and Express
* Experience building multi\-agent systems, AI automated workflows, agents, semantic search, vector databases, or knowledge graph retrieval applications
* Experience designing distributed systems, concurrency, or high\-scale cloud applications
* Experience deploying AI solutions serving 1000\+ users
* Consulting experience or experience working directly with enterprise customers
* Experience building data pipelines, including ETL, ELT, batch, and streaming pipelines for analytics and AI applications
* Experience pre\-training or fine\-tuning LLMs


**We are actively seeking candidates for full\-time, remote work within the US, COL and UK. Atlanta\-based applicants will have the opportunity to work in our headquarters in Sandy Springs, GA.**

jobs.title: Solutions Platform Engineer
jobs.description:
At Appfire, we believe that great work happens when people get to choose how they work. After 20 years of creating software that empowers teams to break silos and collaborate seamlessly, we've learned that one size does not fit all. We're a team of 800\+ employees, working remotely across 28 countries. Our flagship products include: JXL, Comala Document Management, 7Pace Time Tracker, Jira Misc Workflow Extensions, and BigPicture.



Here you can read some of our customer stories: https://appfire.com/resources/resource\-library/customer\-stories

**About the role:**



As a Solutions Platform Engineer, you'll build and run the technical infrastructure that supports Appfire's Solutions Group. You'll own our demo environments end to end, build self\-service sandboxes for Solution Partners, and automate technical processes that enable Sales Engineers and Solutions Architects to spend more time with customers. You'll also help transition successful field\-built prototypes into production by partnering with Engineering and DevOps on code ownership, hosting, and support models. This is a highly cross\-functional role focused on reducing technical overhead, improving time\-to\-demo, and creating scalable solutions infrastructure.


**What you'll do:**


* Own the demo estate end to end, including Atlassian instance provisioning, realistic seeded datasets, multi\-product reference environments, and environment teardown and refresh.
* Build and maintain self\-service sandbox environments that enable Solution Partners to demonstrate Appfire products independently.
* Design and implement automation that reduces technical overhead for Sales Engineering and Solutions Architecture teams and improves time\-to\-demo.
* Maintain the technical knowledge base supporting security questionnaires, RFPs, and trust center responses.
* Run the Instance Optimization inventory extract and pricing pull supporting Appfire's consolidation assessment.
* Take ownership of field\-built prototypes that graduate to production, including code ownership, hosting, deployment, and ongoing support in partnership with Engineering and DevOps.
* Define and enforce technical graduation criteria for prototypes moving from pilot to production, ensuring each solution has clear ownership, hosting, and support models.
* Monitor demo environment health, provisioning performance, and capacity, proactively identifying and resolving technical bottlenecks.


**What you'll need:**


* 3\+ years of hands\-on experience in platform engineering, DevOps, or systems engineering, ideally supporting a sales engineering, solutions, or presales organization.
* Hands\-on experience administering and provisioning Atlassian Cloud and/or Data Center environments, including Jira, Confluence, and/or Bitbucket.
* Experience building and operating self\-service sandbox or demo environments, including environment lifecycle management and seeded or synthetic data.
* Strong experience with infrastructure automation, scripting such as Python or Bash, and Infrastructure\-as\-Code practices.
* Practical experience with containerization and orchestration technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes, and CI/CD tooling.
* Experience taking ownership of existing tools or prototypes and preparing them for production, including code review, hosting, deployment, and support.
* Strong written communication skills, with the ability to create clear technical documentation, runbooks, and knowledge bases for both technical and non\-technical audiences.
* Proven ability to collaborate effectively across Solutions, Sales Engineering, Product Engineering, and DevOps teams in a fast\-moving environment.


**What we offer:**


* Help build the technical platform and operating model that enables Appfire's Solutions organization to scale.
* Opportunity to define and automate how demo environments, partner sandboxes, and field\-built solutions are built and operated.
* Work across Appfire's product portfolio and the Atlassian ecosystem with direct impact on how our solutions teams support customers and partners


**Company Equity:** Every Appfire team member is eligible for company equity, fostering a strong sense of ownership and connection to our growth.


**Time Off \& Wellbeing**


* 26 Vacation Days: Paid vacation annually, regardless of tenure  

Wellness Days: 1 fully paid day off each month for rest, recovery, or unexpected personal needs  

Volunteering: 24 hours of paid volunteer time plus 3 fully paid volunteering days


**Learning \& Development**


* Appfire University: Custom, on\-demand learning platform supporting continuous learning, professional development, and career growth
* Health \& Insurance
* Private Healthcare: Fully covered Luxmed plan, with the option to extend coverage to your partner or add personalized upgrades  

Life Insurance: Fully paid UNUM life insurance


**Lifestyle \& Everyday Benefits**


* MyBenefit: 150 PLN per month for a Multisport card, shopping, restaurants, and entertainment
* Lunch Card: 300 PLN per month for groceries or dining out via a virtual Pluxee card, with Google Pay and Apple Wallet support
* Remote Work Support


**Home Office Allowance:** 200 PLN net per month to help cover electricity and internet costs while working remotely

 **Market recognition**



Appfire has been consistently recognized for company growth, culture, corporate social responsibility, and product excellence and has been included among the Deloitte Technology Fast 500, Inc. Best Workplaces, BuiltIn Best Places to Work, and Inc. 5000\. Learn more about our accomplishments, which would not be possible without our team members, partners, and customers: https://appfire.com/awards.

Appfire is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate based on race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, marital status, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic as defined by applicable law. Our commitment extends to all employment practices, including recruitment, hiring, training, promotion, compensation, benefits, and termination.
